actions.name: Ask {world__tobin} about the dragon
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'It goes out over {world__sheepfold} at about watch {roost__leavesAt(roost__dragon)} and comes back near watch {roost__returnsAt(roost__dragon)}. Takes a sheep most days. Never harmed a soul, mind, till folk started going up there with spears.'

actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'The dragon took our bell. Flew off with it in its claws, rope and all. Mother Cate says a chapel without a bell is a barn with ideas. If you could bring it back, any way you can, without burning the village down.'
actions.speaker: roost__ringer

rules.say: {roost__dragon} unfolds its wings, drops off the crag and glides away toward {world__sheepfold}.
{roost__dragon} beats up from {world__sheepfold}, something limp in its claws, and makes for the crag.
{roost__dragon} noses through its hoard, then rears back and screams. Fire splashes across the stone.
Fire falls on {world__green} out of the sky. {roost__barn} goes up like a torch.
Flame runs along {roost__ropes}. The planks drop away into the gorge one by one.
{roost__ringer} takes {roost__chapel_bell} in both hands and runs for the bell-cote.

observations.text: Slate roofs huddle around a sheep-cropped green. Smoke rises from the Hearth's chimney; the chandler's shutters are open, and the chapel's bell-cote stands empty.
A long room with a peat fire and a row of shepherds' crooks by the door.
Rope, tallow, jars of salve and a shelf of stoppered clay pots that smell of ash and lanolin.
A cold little chapel. A rope hangs from the bell-cote with nothing on the end of it.
The road ends at a lip of rock over Skarth Gorge. A rope bridge spans the drop to a ledge on the red crag.
Dry-stone walls, a tally post scored with notches, and a flock that keeps to the far wall. Above the fold, a scree slope climbs toward the shoulder of the red crag.
A wind-scoured saddle of rock. A goat path picks its way around to the ledge.
A wide shelf of rust-red stone, scattered with split bones and scorched wool. A cave mouth opens behind it.
Warm air, and the glint of metal in heaps along the walls.
{roost__dragon} lies coiled across {world__cave_mouth}, one eye open, smoke curling from its nostrils.
{roost__dragon} circles low over {world__sheepfold}, hunting.
{roost__dragon} has drawn its tail aside from {world__cave_mouth} and watches you with something like amusement.
Old hemp ropes and weathered planks. The bridge sways, but it holds.
Charred rope ends hang from the posts. The bridge is gone.
A stone barn under a deep thatch, stuffed with the winter's hay.
The barn is a blackened shell. The winter's hay is ash.
{roost__ringer} keeps glancing up at the empty bell-cote.
{roost__ringer} has the bell rope in hand again and keeps finding reasons to pull it.
The ledge is empty but for split bones and scorched wool.
The great red body lies across the ledge, cooling. The stone around it is black.

objectives.text: {roost__ringer} wants the chapel bell back from the dragon's hoard.

installations.name: Thrale and the Red Crag
installations.description: A shepherds' village in the high country, the gorge below it, the summer pastures, and the red crag across the gorge.

installations.name: A dragon on the crag: A dragon on the crag
installations.description: A dragon has taken a crag above a crossing. It hunts on its own hours, guards its hoard, answers theft with fire, and can be paid, waited out, robbed or fought.
